raw_segments.text: Agist this, this word from thee, this word from one who rose low at the oars beneath,
what time we rule we of the upper tier.
Felt no anon, teas bitter to be taught again in age by one so young submission at the word.
But iron of the chain and hunger's throes can minister unto an orswallen pride marvellous
well, I even in the old.
Hast eyes and cease not this, peace, kick not thus against the pricks unto thy proper
